title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A classic Italian pizza with a crispy thin crust, rich tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, and aromatic basil leaves.
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned crushed San Marzano tomatoes

instructions.title: Preheat the oven
instructions.description: Preheat your oven to its highest setting (usually 500°F/260°C) with a pizza stone inside for at least 45 minutes.

instructions.title: Shape the dough
instructions.description: On a floured surface, gently stretch the pizza dough into a 12-inch circle. Keep the edges slightly thicker for a nice crust.

instructions.title: Add sauce and cheese
instructions.description: Spread the crushed tomatoes evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Arrange the fresh mozzarella slices on top.

instructions.title: Bake the pizza
instructions.description: Transfer the pizza to the preheated stone. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Remove from oven. Immediately top with fresh basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with sea salt. Slice and enjoy!

title: Authentic Shoyu Ramen
description: A comforting Japanese noodle soup with a soy sauce-based chicken and dashi broth, tender chashu pork, and soft-boiled ramen egg.
ingredients: Nori sheets and bamboo shoots (menma) for topping

instructions.title: Prepare the broth
instructions.description: Simmer chicken broth with kombu, ginger, and garlic on low heat for 1.5 hours. Discard kombu after 30 minutes to prevent bitterness.

instructions.title: Make the Shoyu Tare
instructions.description: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, a splash of sake, and a pinch of sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes and set aside.

instructions.title: Boil noodles and warm toppings
instructions.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook fresh ramen noodles for 2 minutes. Warm your chashu pork slices in a hot pan.

instructions.title: Assemble the bowls
instructions.description: Place 2 tablespoons of tare in each bowl. Pour in 2 cups of hot broth and stir. Add cooked noodles, folding them neatly.

instructions.title: Add toppings and serve
instructions.description: Top with pork slices, half a soft-boiled egg, bamboo shoots, nori sheet, and a generous handful of green onions. Serve hot.

title: Gourmet Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in a creamy, homemade Caesar dressing, topped with garlic-herb croutons and freshly shaved Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce, washed and chopped
2 anchovy fillets (optional, or 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce)
Salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.title: Bake the croutons
instructions.description: Toss bread cubes with olive oil, salt, and garlic powder. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 10 minutes until golden and crunchy.

instructions.title: Make the dressing
instructions.description: Whisk egg yolk, minced garlic, lemon juice, anchovy paste, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Slowly drizzle olive oil while whisking vigorously.

instructions.title: Toss the greens
instructions.description: Place dried, chopped romaine lettuce in a large wooden bowl. Drizzle half the dressing over the top and toss to coat evenly.

instructions.title: Assemble and garnish
instructions.description: Add croutons, grated Parmesan, and remaining dressing. Toss gently. Top with shaved Parmesan curls and fresh cracked black pepper.

title: Decadent Chocolate Lava Cake
description: A rich chocolate cake with a warm, molten chocolate center. A showstopping dessert that is deceptively easy to make.
ingredients: Powdered sugar and fresh raspberries (optional, for serving)

instructions.title: Prep ramekins and oven
instructions.description: Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C). Butter two 6-ounce ramekins generously and dust with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess.

instructions.title: Melt chocolate and butter
instructions.description: Microwave chocolate and butter in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second increments until melted. Stir until completely smooth.

instructions.title: Whip eggs and sugar
instructions.description: Using an electric mixer, beat the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt together at high speed until pale, thick, and doubled in volume.

instructions.title: Combine ingredients
instructions.description: Gently fold the melted chocolate mixture and flour into the whipped eggs using a rubber spatula until just combined. Do not overmix.

instructions.title: Bake and invert
instructions.description: Divide batter between ramekins. Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges are firm but center is soft. Cool for 1 minute, invert onto plates, dust with powdered sugar.

title: Double Smash Cheeseburger
description: Crispy-edged beef patties, melted American cheese, caramelized onions, and secret burger sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef (80/20 blend, divided into two balls)

instructions.title: Toast the bun and prep sauce
instructions.description: Spread butter on the buns and toast them in a hot skillet until golden. Mix mayo, mustard, relish, and a dash of pepper in a bowl to make the sauce.

instructions.title: Sear the onions
instructions.description: Place sliced onions in the hot cast iron skillet. Place beef balls directly on top of the onions.

instructions.title: Smash the patties
instructions.description: Using a heavy spatula or burger press, smash the patties down as flat as possible. Season generously with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Flip and add cheese
instructions.description: Scrape underneath the patties and flip them over. Immediately place a slice of American cheese on each patty. Cook for 1 minute until cheese melts.

instructions.title: Assemble the burger
instructions.description: Spread sauce on the bottom bun. Stack the two cheesy patties on top of each other. Cover with the top bun and serve immediately.

title: Classic Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender pieces of marinated chicken grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, creamy, spiced tomato curry sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions.title: Marinate the chicken
instructions.description: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, half the garlic-ginger paste, garam masala, cumin, and turmeric in a bowl. Add chicken and marinate for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Sear the chicken
instructions.description: Heat a large skillet or grill pan. Sear chicken pieces in batches until browned on all sides. They do not need to be cooked all the way through.

instructions.title: Build the sauce
instructions.description: Melt butter in a pan. Sauté chopped onions, remaining garlic-ginger paste, and a dash of spices for 5 minutes. Pour in tomato puree and simmer.

instructions.title: Simmer chicken in sauce
instructions.description: Add the seared chicken pieces into the simmering tomato sauce. Cook on low heat for 15 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.

instructions.title: Add cream and garnish
instructions.description: Stir in the heavy cream and let simmer for another 2 minutes. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve with garlic naan.

title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Light, fluffy, and golden-brown buttermilk pancakes. Perfect for a weekend family brunch served with butter and pure maple syrup.
ingredients: Butter and maple syrup for serving

instructions.title: Mix dry ingredients
instructions.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

instructions.title: Whisk wet ingredients
instructions.description: In another bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.

instructions.title: Combine dry and wet
instructions.description: Pour wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir with a spatula until just combined. The batter should be thick and lumpy.

instructions.title: Cook on griddle
instructions.description: Heat a non-stick griddle over medium heat and grease with butter. Pour 1/3 cup of batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top.

instructions.title: Flip and finish
instructions.description: Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown on the other side. Serve immediately with syrup.

title: Fresh Strawberry Mojito
description: A refreshing summer drink featuring muddled fresh strawberries, mint leaves, lime juice, rum, and fizzy soda water.
ingredients: Extra mint and strawberry for garnish

instructions.title: Muddle fruit and herbs
instructions.description: In a tall glass, combine strawberries, mint leaves, lime wedges, and sugar. Use a muddler to gently press and release juices.

instructions.title: Add rum and ice
instructions.description: Pour in white rum and fill the glass with crushed or cubed ice.

instructions.title: Top with soda and stir
instructions.description: Top with club soda. Stir well from the bottom up to distribute the fruit flavors. Garnish with a mint sprig and serve.

title: Tacos Al Pastor
description: Stunning Mexican street tacos with thin slices of marinated spit-roasted pork, grilled pineapple, cilantro, and onions on warm corn tortillas.

instructions.title: Blend the marinade
instructions.description: Blend achiote paste, chipotles, pineapple juice, vinegar, garlic, oregano, cumin, and salt until smooth. Pour over pork and marinate for 4 hours.

instructions.title: Cook the pork
instructions.description: Grill or pan-fry marinated pork slices in a hot skillet with a little oil until nicely charred and fully cooked. Chop into small pieces.

instructions.title: Grill pineapple and toast tortillas
instructions.description: Grill pineapple slices until caramelized, then chop. Warm corn tortillas on a dry skillet until soft and pliable.

instructions.title: Assemble tacos
instructions.description: Double stack two tortillas. Fill with pork, top with grilled pineapple, onions, and fresh cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Healthy Avocado Toast
description: Creamy mashed avocado on toasted artisanal sourdough bread, topped with a soft-poached egg, chili flakes, and microgreens.
ingredients: Sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.title: Toast the sourdough
instructions.description: Drizzle sourdough bread with a little olive oil and toast on a grill pan until crispy and marked.

instructions.title: Mash the avocado
instructions.description: Mash avocado flesh with lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Keep it slightly chunky.

instructions.title: Poach the egg
instructions.description: Bring water to a simmer with a splash of vinegar. Whirl the water to create a vortex, slip in the cracked egg, and cook for 3 minutes.

instructions.title: Assemble and serve
instructions.description: Spread mashed avocado onto the toast. Slide the poached egg on top. Garnish with red pepper flakes, black pepper, and microgreens.

title: Classic Pad Thai
description: The quintessential Thai street food noodle dish: rice noodles stir-fried with firm tofu, eggs, bean sprouts, and peanuts in a tangy tamarind sauce.
ingredients: Lime wedges and red pepper flakes

instructions.title: Soak noodles and prep sauce
instructions.description: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until soft. Whisk tamarind paste, palm sugar, and soy sauce with hot water to dissolve sugar.

instructions.title: Fry tofu and aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a wok. Fry tofu cubes until golden. Add minced garlic and shallots, cooking for 30 seconds.

instructions.title: Scramble the eggs
instructions.description: Push tofu to the side of the wok. Pour in eggs and scramble until set, then mix with tofu.

instructions.title: Toss noodles and sauce
instructions.description: Add drained noodles and tamarind sauce. Stir-fry rapidly, tossing continuously, until noodles absorb sauce and become tender.

instructions.title: Add final garnishes
instructions.description: Toss in bean sprouts, green onions, and half the crushed peanuts. Serve with lime wedges, remaining peanuts, and red pepper flakes.

title: Vegetable Dum Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables, caramelized onions, fresh herbs, and saffron milk, slow-cooked to perfection.
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, potatoes, beans)
2 large onions, thinly sliced and fried until crispy
1/2 cup fresh mint and cilantro, chopped
1/2 tsp saffron threads dissolved in 2 tbsp warm milk
Whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf)

instructions.title: Parboil the rice
instructions.description: Wash and soak Basmati rice for 30 minutes. Boil in salted water with whole spices until 70% cooked. Drain and set aside.

instructions.title: Marinate the vegetables
instructions.description: Mix chopped vegetables with yogurt, biryani masala, half the fried onions, mint, cilantro, oil, and salt. Let sit for 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook vegetable layer
instructions.description: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add marinated vegetables and cook for 10 minutes until par-cooked.

instructions.title: Layer and Dum
instructions.description: Layer parboiled rice over the cooked vegetables. Sprinkle saffron milk, remaining fried onions, ghee, mint, and cilantro. Seal pot with dough or foil.

instructions.title: Slow cook and fluff
instructions.description: Cook on very low heat (dum) for 25-30 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes, then gently fluff layers and serve warm with raita.

title: Artisanal Garlic Herb Sourdough
description: Crusty, slow-fermented sourdough bread packed with roasted garlic cloves and fresh chopped rosemary.

instructions.title: Mix the dough
instructions.description: Combine flour, water, sourdough starter, and salt in a bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then let it rest for 30 minutes.

instructions.title: Fold in herbs and garlic
instructions.description: Gently stretch the dough and fold in the minced garlic and fresh rosemary. Perform stretch-and-folds every 30 minutes for 2 hours.

instructions.title: Bulk fermentation
instructions.description: Cover the dough and let it rise at room temperature for 4 to 6 hours, or until it has doubled in size.

instructions.title: Shape and cold proof
instructions.description: Shape the dough into a tight round loaf. Place in a proofing basket, cover, and refrigerate overnight for 12 hours for deep flavor.

instructions.title: Bake in Dutch oven
instructions.description: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with a Dutch oven inside. Score the loaf, place in the hot Dutch oven, cover with lid, and bake for 20 minutes. Bake 20 minutes uncovered.

title: Soft Garlic Butter Naan
description: Traditional Indian flatbread cooked on a hot skillet, brushed with garlic butter and garnished with fresh cilantro.

instructions.title: Activate yeast and knead
instructions.description: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Add flour, salt, yogurt, and 1 tbsp melted butter. Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

instructions.title: First rise
instructions.description: Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.

instructions.title: Divide and shape
instructions.description: Divide the dough into 6 equal portions. Roll each portion into an oval shape about 1/4 inch thick. Press minced garlic and cilantro onto one side.

instructions.title: Cook on skillet
instructions.description: Heat a heavy cast-iron skillet over high heat. Brush the plain side of the naan with water, then place it water-side down on the hot skillet. Cook until bubbles form.

instructions.title: Flip and brush with butter
instructions.description: Flip the naan and cook for another minute until charred spots appear. Remove from skillet and immediately brush with melted garlic butter.

title: Authentic Mango Lassi
description: A creamy, smooth, and refreshing classic Indian drink made with sweet mangoes, yogurt, a touch of cardamom, and saffron.
ingredients: 1 cup ripe mango pulp or fresh cubed mango

instructions.title: Prep the mangoes
instructions.description: Peel and chop fresh sweet mangoes into cubes, discarding the pit. Ensure they are cold for a refreshing drink.

instructions.title: Blend ingredients
instructions.description: Add mango cubes, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and ground cardamom to a high-speed blender.

instructions.title: Blend until smooth
instructions.description: Blend on high for 1-2 minutes until completely smooth, frothy, and thick. Adjust sweetness or thickness if desired.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Pour into glasses over ice. Garnish with a sprinkle of ground cardamom and a few saffron threads. Serve chilled immediately.

title: Quinoa Avocado Buddha Bowl
description: A nutrient-rich and colorful grain bowl featuring fluffy quinoa, ripe avocado, fresh spinach, and seasoned roasted chickpeas.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions.title: Cook the quinoa
instructions.description: Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine quinoa and water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Roast chickpeas
instructions.description: Toss chickpeas with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in a pan on medium-high heat until slightly crispy (about 8 minutes).

instructions.title: Prepare dressing
instructions.description: Whisk together remaining olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper to create a zesty dressing.

instructions.title: Assemble the bowl
instructions.description: Divide cooked quinoa into two bowls. Arrange slices of avocado, spinach, roasted chickpeas, tomatoes, and cucumber in sections on top.

instructions.title: Drizzle dressing and serve
instructions.description: Drizzle the lemon dressing over the bowls, garnish with sesame seeds or microgreens, and serve fresh.

title: Classic Italian Tiramisu
description: An elegant, traditional Italian dessert layered with espresso-soaked ladyfingers and a rich, velvety mascarpone cream.

instructions.title: Whip egg yolks and sugar
instructions.description: In a bowl over a pot of simmering water, whisk egg yolks and sugar for 5 minutes until pale and creamy. Remove from heat and let cool.

instructions.title: Incorporate mascarpone
instructions.description: Gently fold the mascarpone cheese into the cooled egg yolk mixture until smooth and combined.

instructions.title: Whip heavy cream
instructions.description: In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Gently fold this into the mascarpone cream.

instructions.title: Dip ladyfingers
instructions.description: Quickly dip ladyfinger cookies into the cold espresso. Arrange them in a single layer in a serving dish.

instructions.title: Layer and dust cocoa
instructions.description: Spread half the mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers. Add another layer of ladyfingers, top with remaining cream, and dust with cocoa powder. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Tender pieces of chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, seared and simmered in a luscious, velvety tomato-butter gravy.

instructions.title: Marinate the chicken
instructions.description: Marinate chicken with yogurt, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, and salt for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.description: Cook chicken in a hot pan until lightly browned and seared on all sides.

instructions.title: Sauté the onions
instructions.description: Heat butter in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until golden brown.

instructions.title: Cook ginger-garlic paste
instructions.description: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until the raw aroma disappears.

instructions.title: Simmer in tomato gravy
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, cook until oil separates. Stir in the chicken, simmer for 10 minutes, and mix in cream.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with warm butter naan or steamed basmati rice.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Soft cottage cheese cubes simmered in a velvety, buttery tomato-based gravy seasoned with delicate spices.

instructions.title: Fry the paneer
instructions.description: Fry paneer cubes lightly in a pan with butter until slightly golden on the edges.

instructions.title: Cook the onions
instructions.description: Sauté the chopped onions in butter until golden brown and soft.

instructions.title: Sauté ginger-garlic
instructions.description: Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute until aromatic.

instructions.title: Thicken the tomato puree
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, chili powder, and cook until thick and fat starts separating.

instructions.title: Incorporate paneer and cream
instructions.description: Add paneer, garam masala, salt, and mix in cream. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Chole
description: A classic North Indian chickpea curry cooked in a spicy, tangy onion-tomato gravy with special chole spices.
ingredients: Fresh coriander leaves, chopped for garnish

instructions.title: Boil the Chickpeas
instructions.description: Drain the soaked chickpeas. Boil them in a pressure cooker with 4 cups of water, a tea bag (for dark color), and a pinch of salt for 5-6 whistles until soft.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a deep pan. Add cumin seeds. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, and cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook Tomato Base & Spices
instructions.description: Pour in the tomato puree. Cook for 5 minutes until oil separates. Add chole masala, red chili powder, turmeric, salt, and amchur powder. Sauté for 1 minute.

instructions.title: Simmer the Curry
instructions.description: Add the boiled chickpeas and the cooking water. Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy. Simmer on medium-low heat for 15 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

title: Palak Paneer
description: Cubes of fresh paneer in a creamy, green, and vibrant spiced spinach puree gravy.
ingredients: 250 g Paneer (cottage cheese), cut into cubes
500 g Fresh spinach (palak) leaves, washed thoroughly

instructions.title: Blanch the Spinach
instructions.description: Boil spinach leaves for 2 minutes, then plunge into ice-cold water to retain green color. Grind into a smooth paste with green chilies.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat butter or oil, add cumin seeds, chopped onions and sauté until translucent. Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Combine & Simmer
instructions.description: Add chopped tomatoes, cook until mushy. Add the spinach paste, salt, and a little water. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Paneer & Cream
instructions.description: Add paneer cubes and garam masala. Gently simmer for 3 minutes. Stir in fresh cream, cook for 1 minute, and turn off heat.

title: Kashmiri Rajma Masala
description: Rich red kidney beans slow-cooked in a spiced tomato-onion curry gravy, served classically with steamed rice.

instructions.title: Boil Rajma
instructions.description: Boil soaked kidney beans in a pressure cooker with 4 cups of water and salt for 6-8 whistles until completely soft.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, chopped onions, and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 mins.

instructions.title: Cook Gravy & Simmer
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, cook until ghee separates. Add spices, boiled rajma, and water. Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Stir in garam masala.

title: South Indian Masala Dosa
description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe stuffed with a dry, seasoned potato-onion mash.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Urad dal (black gram), soaked for 5 hours

instructions.title: Prepare Batter
instructions.description: Grind soaked rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds into a smooth batter. Mix in salt and ferment overnight (8-10 hours).

instructions.title: Prepare Potato Bhaji
instructions.description: Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds, add curry leaves, green chilies, and onions. Sauté. Add turmeric, salt, mashed potatoes, and mix well.

instructions.title: Cook Dosa & Assemble
instructions.description: Spread a ladle of batter in a thin circle on a hot tawa. Drizzle oil/butter, cook until crisp and golden. Place potato filling in the center and fold.

title: Soft Steamed Idlis
description: Healthy, soft, and fluffy steamed cakes made from fermented rice and black lentil batter.
ingredients: 2 cups Idli Rice (parboiled rice), soaked for 5 hours
1/2 cup Urad dal (whole skinless black gram), soaked for 5 hours

instructions.title: Grind & Ferment Batter
instructions.description: Grind urad dal and fenugreek seeds into a fluffy batter. Grind rice coarsely. Combine, add salt, and ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours.

instructions.title: Steam the Idlis
instructions.description: Grease idli plates with oil. Pour batter into molds and steam in a cooker (without whistle) or steamer for 10-12 minutes.

instructions.title: De-mold and Serve
instructions.description: Let idlis cool for 2 minutes. De-mold with a wet spoon and serve warm with sambar and coconut chutney.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
description: Richly spiced Basmati rice layered with marinated chicken, saffron, fried onions, mint, and slow-cooked (dum) to locking absolute flavor.
ingredients: 500 g Chicken, cut into medium pieces
2 cups Basmati rice, washed and soaked for 30 minutes
2 large Onions, sliced thinly and deep-fried (biryani onions)
1/2 cup Fresh mint and coriander leaves, chopped
Whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon)

instructions.title: Marinate Chicken
instructions.description: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, half of the fried onions, mint, coriander, oil, and salt for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Boil Basmati Rice
instructions.description: Boil water with whole spices and salt. Add soaked rice and cook until 70% done. Drain and set aside.

instructions.title: Layer and Dum Cook
instructions.description: In a heavy-bottomed pot, place the marinated chicken. Layer the partially cooked rice on top. Garnish with remaining fried onions, ghee, mint, and saffron. Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 25-30 minutes.

title: Crispy Punjabi Samosa
description: Golden, crispy pastry shells filled with a spiced potato and green peas mash, served with sweet tamarind chutney.
ingredients: 2 cups Maida (all-purpose flour) for the dough
4 tbsp Ghee or oil for shortening
3 large Potatoes, boiled, peeled, and crumbled

instructions.title: Knead Samosa Crust Dough
instructions.description: Mix flour, ajwain, salt, and ghee. Knead with cold water into a stiff dough. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.

instructions.title: Prepare Potato Stuffing
instructions.description: Heat oil, sauté ginger and green chilies. Add peas, crumbled potatoes, spices, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes, then let cool.

instructions.title: Shape & Deep Fry
instructions.description: Divide dough into balls. Roll thin, cut in half. Fold into cones, fill with potato mixture, seal edges with water, and deep fry in low-medium oil until golden brown.

title: Soft Milk-Solid Gulab Jamun
description: Warm milk-powder dumplings lightly fried and soaked in a sweet cardamom-infused sugar syrup.
ingredients: Ghee or oil for deep frying

instructions.title: Prepare Sugar Syrup
instructions.description: Boil sugar and water with cardamoms for 5-8 minutes until sticky. Keep warm.

instructions.title: Make Jamun Balls
instructions.description: Mash khoya, flour, and baking powder together with a little milk to form a soft, smooth dough. Shape into small, crack-free balls.

instructions.title: Fry and Soak
instructions.description: Fry balls on very low heat in ghee until dark golden brown. Drain and transfer immediately into warm sugar syrup. Soak for 2 hours before serving.

title: Poha
description: A light and healthy Indian breakfast staple made of flattened rice flakes sautéed with onions, potatoes, mustard seeds, and turmeric.

instructions.title: Wash and drain poha
instructions.description: Wash the poha under running water in a colander, drain all water completely, and keep aside to soften.

instructions.title: Sauté mustard and aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, let them crackle, then add curry leaves and chopped green chilies.

instructions.title: Cook onions and potatoes
instructions.description: Add chopped onions and cook until soft. Add diced potatoes and cook on low heat until they are completely tender.

instructions.title: Combine and serve
instructions.description: Stir in turmeric powder, salt, and washed poha. Mix gently. Cook for 3-4 minutes, add lemon juice, garnish with chopped coriander, and serve.

title: Upma
description: A popular South Indian breakfast dish made by cooking dry-roasted semolina with water, vegetables, and seasoned tempered spices.

instructions.title: Dry Roast Semolina
instructions.description: Dry roast semolina on medium heat until fragrant, stirring continuously. Keep aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Spices & Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Splutter mustard seeds, then add urad dal, curry leaves, green chilies, and onions. Sauté until translucent.

instructions.title: Boil Water & Stir
instructions.description: Pour in water, add salt, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, add roasted semolina slowly in a stream while stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Cover and cook on low for 3 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

title: Medu Vada
description: Crispy, deep-fried fritters shaped like doughnuts, made of fermented black lentil (urad dal) batter.
ingredients: 1 cup Urad Dal (split skinless black gram), soaked for 4 hours

instructions.title: Grind Urad Dal
instructions.description: Drain soaked urad dal completely. Grind into a very thick, fluffy batter using minimal ice-cold water.

instructions.title: Aerate & Spice Batter
instructions.description: Beat the batter vigorously with your hands for 5 minutes to incorporate air. Add ginger, chilies, curry leaves, salt, and hing. Mix well.

instructions.title: Shape & Deep Fry
instructions.description: Wet your hands. Take a ball of batter, shape it, make a hole in the center, and drop it into hot oil. Fry on medium heat until golden brown and crispy. Drain and serve.

title: Pav Bhaji
description: A delicious spiced blend of mashed mixed vegetables cooked in a pool of butter, served hot with toasted pav buns.

instructions.title: Mash Vegetables
instructions.description: Mash the boiled potatoes, cauliflower, and peas together with a vegetable masher until smooth.

instructions.title: Prepare Spicy Bhaji
instructions.description: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan. Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add pav bhaji masala, salt, and the mashed vegetables. Add water, cook for 10 minutes, and mash further. Stir in coriander and remaining butter.

instructions.title: Toast Pav Buns
instructions.description: Slit pav buns. Melt butter on a hot tawa with a pinch of pav bhaji masala. Toast pav buns on both sides until warm and golden. Serve hot with bhaji and lemon.

title: Vada Pav
description: The ultimate Mumbai street food: a spiced potato dumpling fried in gram flour batter, sandwiched in a soft pav with garlic chutney.
ingredients: 2 Green chilies and 4 garlic cloves (pounded into paste)

instructions.title: Make Potato Filling
instructions.description: Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds, add curry leaves, green chili-garlic paste, and turmeric. Stir into mashed potatoes with salt. Shape into round balls.

instructions.title: Batter & Deep Fry
instructions.description: Prepare a thick batter of besan, water, salt, and turmeric. Dip potato balls into the batter and deep-fry in hot oil until golden.

instructions.title: Assemble Vada Pav
instructions.description: Slit pav buns, spread green/garlic chutneys inside, insert hot potato vada, and serve immediately.

title: Aloo Paratha
description: Golden skillet flatbread stuffed with a seasoned spicy potato filling, cooked with ghee and served with yogurt.
ingredients: 3 large Potatoes, boiled, peeled, and mashed

instructions.title: Knead Whole Wheat Dough
instructions.description: Knead wheat flour, salt, and water into a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest for 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Prepare Potato Stuffing
instructions.description: Mix mashed potatoes, chopped green chilies, ajwain, garam masala, and salt together thoroughly.

instructions.title: Stuff, Roll, and Roast
instructions.description: Roll a small ball of dough, place potato stuffing inside, seal the edges, and roll flat. Roast on a hot tawa with ghee on both sides until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Capsicum
description: Tender green bell peppers stuffed with a spicy potato and green pea mixture, pan-cooked to a perfect soft finish.
ingredients: 4 medium Green bell peppers (capsicum), washed and dried
3 large Potatoes, boiled, peeled, and mashed

instructions.title: Prepare Capsicum Caps
instructions.description: Carefully cut off the top stalk of each capsicum. Remove the seeds and white ribs inside to create a hollow cavity for the stuffing. Keep the top caps for baking/cooking.

instructions.title: Cook the Potato Stuffing
instructions.description: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Sauté chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste until soft. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander-cumin powder, amchur, and salt. Stir in the mashed potatoes and coriander leaves. Cook for 3 minutes, then remove and let cool.

instructions.title: Stuff the Peppers
instructions.description: Stuff the spiced potato mixture tightly into the hollow capsicum cavities. Press it down with a spoon so it is fully packed.

instructions.title: Pan-Sear and Roast
instructions.description: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a deep frying pan or kadai. Place the stuffed capsicum upright. Cover and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes, rotating them occasionally so that all sides get tender, slightly blistered, and cooked.

title: Baingan Bharta
description: Fire-roasted eggplant mashed and cooked with onions, tomatoes, garlic, and aromatic Indian spices.

instructions.title: Roast the Eggplant
instructions.description: Wash eggplant. Make 3-4 deep vertical slits and insert garlic cloves into them. Brush with mustard oil. Roast directly over a gas flame, turning frequently, until the skin chars, wrinkles, and the flesh becomes soft (approx. 10-12 minutes).

instructions.title: Peel and Mash
instructions.description: Let the roasted eggplant cool in a closed bowl. Peel off the charred skin. Mash the roasted flesh thoroughly with a fork, discarding the stem.

instructions.title: Sauté Spices
instructions.description: Heat mustard oil in a pan. Sauté chopped onions, ginger, and green chilies. Fry until golden. Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are completely mushy.

instructions.title: Cook Bharta
instructions.description: Add the mashed eggplant to the pan. Mix well and cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 7-8 minutes. Stir in garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with rotis.

title: Bhindi Masala
description: Crispy pan-fried okra tossed in a seasoned tomato-onion dry masala base.
ingredients: 250 g Okra (bhindi), washed, dried completely, and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions.title: Prep and Roast Bhindi
instructions.description: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wide pan. Add okra (bhindi) and cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until they are dry, lightly browned, and non-sticky. Remove okra from pan.

instructions.title: Temper & Cook Onions
instructions.description: Add another 1 tbsp oil to the same pan. Add cumin seeds. Sauté sliced onions until soft and golden brown.

instructions.title: Combine Spices
instructions.description: Reduce heat, add turmeric, coriander powder, red chili powder, amchur powder, and salt. Stir well for 1 minute.

instructions.title: Final Okra Toss
instructions.description: Add the roasted okra back to the pan. Mix gently to coat with spices. Cook uncovered on low heat for 5-7 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Jeera Rice
description: Premium Basmati rice sautéed in ghee and whole cumin seeds, making the perfect companion for dals and curries.
ingredients: 1 cup Basmati Rice, washed and soaked for 20 minutes

instructions.title: Toast Cumin Seeds
instructions.description: Melt ghee or butter in a pot on medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle and toast until dark brown and aromatic.

instructions.title: Sauté Rice
instructions.description: Drain the soaked basmati rice. Add it to the pot and gently sauté for 1-2 minutes, coating the grains with ghee without breaking them.

instructions.title: Simmer & Fluff
instructions.description: Add 2 cups of water and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover with a tight lid and cook on low heat for 10-12 minutes until all water is absorbed. Let stand for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork, and garnish with coriander.

title: Lemon Rice
description: Crispy-tempered South Indian rice mixed with fresh lemon juice, roasted peanuts, mustard seeds, and curry leaves.

instructions.title: Temper Spices & Peanuts
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds. Once they splutter, add chana dal, peanuts, and curry leaves. Roast on low-medium heat until the peanuts are crunchy and golden.

instructions.title: Add Turmeric & Aromatics
instructions.description: Add chopped green chilies, turmeric powder, and salt. Stir for 30 seconds on low heat, then remove from flame.

instructions.title: Mix Rice & Lemon
instructions.description: Add lemon juice to the pan, then add the cooled cooked rice. Gently mix until the rice is evenly coated in a bright yellow color. Serve warm.

title: Tamarind Rice
description: A tangy, spicy rice dish prepared with tamarind pulp, peanuts, and aromatic tempering spices.

instructions.title: Prepare Tamarind Reduction
instructions.description: In a small pan, simmer tamarind paste with 1/2 cup water, puliyogare spice mix, and salt for 5 minutes until it thickens into a paste.

instructions.title: Temper Crunchy Toppings
instructions.description: Heat oil in another pan. Sauté mustard seeds, peanuts, and curry leaves until peanuts are roasted and crunchy.

instructions.title: Toss and Blend Rice
instructions.description: Add the tamarind reduction and tempered crunchy ingredients into the cooled cooked rice. Mix thoroughly until the rice is aromatic and deep brownish-red.

title: Vegetable Pulao
description: One-pot spiced rice dish cooked with mixed vegetables and fragrant whole spices.
ingredients: 1 cup Basmati Rice, washed and soaked for 20 minutes
1 cup Mixed chopped vegetables (beans, carrots, peas, corn)
Whole spices (1 bay leaf, 3 cloves, 2 cardamom, 1 cinnamon stick)

instructions.title: Sauté Whole Spices
instructions.description: Heat ghee or oil in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, and cinnamon. Sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Add Veggies & Rice
instructions.description: Add the mixed vegetables and sauté for 2 minutes. Drain rice, add to the pot, and stir gently to toast for 1 minute.

instructions.title: Simmer Pulao
instructions.description: Pour in 2 cups of water and add salt. Bring to a boil, then cover tightly and simmer on low heat for 10-12 minutes until cooked and grains are fluffy.

title: Veg Fried Rice
description: Steamed rice stir-fried in a hot wok with finely chopped carrots, beans, bell peppers, soy sauce, and spring onions.
ingredients: 1 cup Finely chopped vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage)
1.5 tbsp Soy sauce & 1 tsp black pepper powder

instructions.title: Stir Fry Veggies
instructions.description: Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry rapidly for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.

instructions.title: Season with Sauces
instructions.description: Add soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and salt. Stir-fry for 30 seconds on high heat.

instructions.title: Toss Cooked Rice
instructions.description: Add the cooled cooked rice and spring onions. Toss gently on high heat for 2 minutes and serve hot.

title: Chicken Curry
description: A classic homestyle Indian chicken curry cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and special chicken curry spices.
ingredients: 500 g Chicken, cut into curry pieces
1/2 tsp Turmeric & 1 tsp Kashmiri red chili powder

instructions.title: Sauté Onions & Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pot, fry chopped onions until golden brown. Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook Gravy Base
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, chicken masala, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Sauté on medium heat until the masala thickens and oil starts separating.

instructions.title: Sear Chicken
instructions.description: Add chicken curry pieces. Sauté on high heat for 5 minutes, coating the chicken with the spices.

instructions.title: Simmer to Tender
instructions.description: Pour in 1.5 cups of warm water. Cover and simmer on low-medium heat for 25-30 minutes until chicken is completely tender. Garnish with coriander.

title: Fish Curry
description: Goan-style coastal fish curry cooked with mild spices and rich, creamy coconut milk gravy.
ingredients: 500 g Fish fillets (Kingfish or Pomfret), cut into chunks

instructions.title: Temper & Cook Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat coconut oil, splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, and sauté onions until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Spices & Coconut Milk
instructions.description: Add turmeric, chili powder, and salt. Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a very gentle simmer.

instructions.title: Poach Fish Fillets
instructions.description: Slide the fish fillets gently into the coconut gravy. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 minutes.

instructions.title: Simmer & Garnish
instructions.description: Gently shake the pot to mix (do not stir to avoid breaking fish). Cook uncovered for 2 minutes and garnish with curry leaves. Serve with rice.

title: Egg Curry
description: Boiled eggs cooked in a delicious, spicy onion-tomato gravy with curry spices.
ingredients: 6 Hard-boiled eggs, peeled and lightly slit
1 tsp Garam masala & 1 tsp red chili powder

instructions.title: Pan-Fry Boiled Eggs
instructions.description: Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan, toss eggs with a pinch of turmeric and chili powder for 2 minutes until blistered and golden. Set aside.

instructions.title: Cook Onion-Tomato Masala
instructions.description: Heat remaining oil. Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste until brown. Add tomato puree and spices, cook until oil separates.

instructions.title: Simmer Eggs in Gravy
instructions.description: Add 1 cup water, salt, and the fried eggs to the gravy. Cover and simmer on low for 10 minutes.

instructions.title: Final Thickening
instructions.description: Uncover and cook until the gravy reaches your desired thick consistency. Garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Rogan Josh
description: A signature Kashmiri mutton (lamb) dish cooked with yogurt, Kashmiri red chilies, and flavored with cardamom and ginger.
ingredients: 500 g Mutton (lamb or goat), cut into pieces
1 tbsp Ginger paste & 1 tbsp Garlic paste
2 tsp Kashmiri red chili powder (for red color)

instructions.title: Sear Mutton with Spices
instructions.description: Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pot. Crackle whole spices, add mutton pieces, and sear on high heat for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Stir in Yogurt & Chilies
instructions.description: Lower heat. Mix kashmiri chili powder with ginger-garlic paste and stir into mutton. Add beaten yogurt slowly, stirring constantly.

instructions.title: Slow Cook Curry
instructions.description: Add 2 cups of water and salt. Cover and simmer on low heat for 45-50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mutton is fork-tender.

instructions.title: Spice Finishes
instructions.description: Sprinkle garam masala and chopped fennel powder. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes until gravy is rich, then serve warm.

title: Mutton Keema
description: Finely minced mutton cooked with onions, tomatoes, fresh green peas, and warm garam masala.
ingredients: 1 tsp Red chili powder & 1/2 tsp garam masala

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics & Veggies
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste until brown. Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.

instructions.title: Cook Minced Keema
instructions.description: Add minced keema and sauté on high heat for 10 minutes, breaking any lumps. Add keema masala and chili powder.

instructions.title: Add Peas & Water
instructions.description: Pour in 1 cup of warm water, add green peas and salt. Mix well.

instructions.title: Slow Simmer
instructions.description: Cover and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until meat is cooked and peas are tender. Finish with garam masala.

title: Prawn Masala
description: Spicy, dry-cooked prawns in an onion-tomato gravy with red chili, turmeric, and lime juice.
ingredients: 1 tsp Red chili powder & 1/2 tsp turmeric

instructions.title: Sauté Curry Base
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Fry onions, curry leaves, and ginger-garlic paste until translucent. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.

instructions.title: Add Spices
instructions.description: Add red chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Sauté for 2 minutes on low heat until the spices are aromatic.

instructions.title: Cook Prawns
instructions.description: Toss in the prawns. Cook on medium heat, stirring gently, for exactly 5-6 minutes until the prawns turn pink and curled. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka
description: Marinated boneless chicken skewers baked in the oven until tender and smoky on the edges.
ingredients: 500 g Chicken breast, cut into bite-sized cubes

instructions.title: Blend Marinade
instructions.description: In a bowl, whisk yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, tandoori masala, red chili, lemon juice, oil, and salt until smooth.

instructions.title: Marinate Chicken
instructions.description: Add chicken cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

instructions.title: Skewering
instructions.description: Thread chicken cubes onto pre-soaked wooden or metal skewers, leaving a small space between pieces.

instructions.title: Grill and Char
instructions.description: Grill in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) or on a hot grill pan for 15-20 minutes, basting with butter, until cooked through and lightly charred.

title: Tandoori Chicken
description: Classic whole chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and tandoori spices, grilled to absolute perfection.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Lemon juice & 1 tbsp mustard oil

instructions.title: First Marinade
instructions.description: Rub lemon juice and salt all over the slashed chicken drumsticks. Rest for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Second Marinade
instructions.description: Whisk yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, kashmiri chili, tandoori masala, and mustard oil. Apply to chicken and marinate for 2 hours.

instructions.title: Preheat & Bake
instructions.description: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Place chicken on a baking sheet lined with foil.

instructions.title: Roast drumsticks
instructions.description: Roast for 25-30 minutes, brushing with butter halfway through, until cooked and edges are beautifully charred.

title: Chicken Korma
description: A Mughlai style chicken dish simmered in a rich, velvety yogurt-cashew paste gravy.

instructions.title: Sear Chicken with Aromatics
instructions.description: Heat ghee, sauté whole spices until fragrant. Add ginger-garlic paste and chicken pieces. Sear on medium-high for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Stir in Onion & Yogurt
instructions.description: Reduce heat. Stir in fried onion puree, yogurt, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until chicken absorbs the flavors.

instructions.title: Simmer with Cashew Paste
instructions.description: Add cashew paste and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20-25 minutes until chicken is completely tender.

instructions.title: Finish Gravy
instructions.description: Sprinkle garam masala. Simmer uncovered for 2 minutes until the gravy is smooth, velvety, and oil floats on top.

title: Dhokla
description: Steamed savory chickpea flour (gram flour) cake topped with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies.

instructions.title: Whisk Batter
instructions.description: Mix besan, sooji, water, lemon juice, salt, and sugar into a smooth batter. Rest for 10 minutes.

instructions.title: Activate & Steam
instructions.description: Just before steaming, add Eno fruit salt and stir quickly until frothy. Immediately pour into a greased pan and steam for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Prepare Sweet Tempering
instructions.description: Heat oil in a small pan, splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, and chilies. Pour in 1/2 cup water and 1 tsp sugar. Bring to a boil.

instructions.title: Cut & Soak
instructions.description: Cut the dhokla into cubes. Pour the warm tempering water evenly over the dhokla, allowing it to absorb and become juicy. Serve warm.

title: Khandvi
description: Delicate, thin rolled Gujarati snacks made from gram flour and yogurt, tempered with sesame and mustard seeds.
ingredients: 1 tsp Mustard seeds & 1 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.title: Whisk & Cook Batter
instructions.description: Whisk besan, yogurt, water, turmeric, ginger-chili paste, and salt into a lump-free batter. Cook on medium-low heat in a pan, stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes.

instructions.title: Test Consistency
instructions.description: Spread a small spoonful of paste on a plate. If it rolls easily after cooling, the batter is cooked. If not, cook for 1-2 minutes more.

instructions.title: Spread & Roll
instructions.description: Quickly spread the hot paste in a thin layer over greased backs of plates. Let cool, slice into 1.5-inch strips, and roll tightly into spirals.

instructions.title: Tempering Finish
instructions.description: Heat oil, crackle mustard and sesame seeds. Pour over the rolled khandvi, garnish with coconut and coriander.

title: Thepla
description: Spiced flatbread made of whole wheat flour, fresh fenugreek leaves (methi), and yogurt.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Fresh fenugreek leaves (methi), finely chopped
1/2 tsp Turmeric & 1/2 tsp red chili powder

instructions.title: Knead Thepla Dough
instructions.description: Knead whole wheat flour, chopped methi leaves, turmeric, cumin, chili powder, salt, yogurt, and 1 tbsp oil into a soft dough.

instructions.title: Roll Thin
instructions.description: Divide dough into equal balls. Roll them out into very thin circles on a floured board.

instructions.title: Roast on Tawa
instructions.description: Roast on a hot tawa with a drizzle of oil/ghee. Press gently with a cloth or spatula, cooking both sides until golden spots appear.

title: Handvo
description: A traditional baked savory cake made of mixed lentils, rice, grated bottle gourd, and sesame tempering.
ingredients: 1 cup Rice & 1/2 cup mixed lentils (toor, chana, urad dal), soaked for 4 hours
1 tsp Mustard seeds & 1 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.title: Make Handvo Batter
instructions.description: Grind soaked rice and lentils into a thick batter. Stir in the grated bottle gourd, salt, sugar, and Eno just before cooking.

instructions.title: Tempering the Pan
instructions.description: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a non-stick pan, add mustard seeds, sesame seeds, and curry leaves. Let them sizzle.

instructions.title: Cook Handvo Cake
instructions.description: Pour batter into the pan. Cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes until bottom is crispy. Flip, cover, and cook other side for 8 minutes.

title: Misal Pav
description: A spicy sprout curry (usal) topped with crispy farsan, chopped onions, and lemon, served with pav buns.

instructions.title: Cook Moth Beans
instructions.description: Boil sprouted moth beans in water with turmeric and salt until tender.

instructions.title: Prepare Spicy Kat Gravy
instructions.description: Heat oil. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and misal masala. Add water and boil into a thin, fiery red spicy gravy (Kat).

instructions.title: Toast Pav Buns
instructions.description: Lightly butter and toast pav buns on a hot tawa until soft and warm.

instructions.title: Layer and Serve
instructions.description: In a bowl, layer boiled matki sprouts, pour Kat gravy, top with farsan, raw onions, and coriander. Serve with pav and lemon.

title: Sabudana Khichdi
description: A gluten-free breakfast dish made of tapioca pearls (sabudana), roasted peanuts, diced potatoes, and green chilies.
ingredients: 1 cup Sago (Sabudana), washed and soaked with water just covering it for 5 hours
2 tbsp Ghee or cooking oil & curry leaves

instructions.title: Drain Sabudana
instructions.description: Ensure the soaked sabudana is drained completely and grains are separate and soft to touch.

instructions.title: Sauté Toppings
instructions.description: Heat ghee. Sauté cumin seeds, curry leaves, chopped green chilies, boiled potatoes, and roasted peanuts.

instructions.title: Combine & Simmer
instructions.description: Add sabudana and salt. Mix gently. Cook covered on low heat, stirring occasionally, until sago pearls turn translucent. Drizzle lemon juice.

title: Pesarattu
description: Andhra style healthy green gram (whole moong dal) crepes, served with ginger chutney.
ingredients: 1.5 cups Whole green gram (green moong), soaked for 5 hours

instructions.title: Grind Moong Batter
instructions.description: Grind soaked moong, ginger, green chilies, cumin seeds, salt, and water into a smooth batter.

instructions.title: Cook Crepe
instructions.description: Pour batter on a hot tawa and spread in a thin circle. Drizzle oil or ghee around the edges.

instructions.title: Crisp and Fold
instructions.description: Top with chopped raw onions if desired. Cook until golden brown and crispy, fold, and serve hot.

title: Rasam
description: A tangy, spicy, and warming South Indian soup made with tamarind, tomatoes, black pepper, cumin, and garlic.
ingredients: 2 tbsp Tamarind pulp mixed with 2 cups water
1.5 tbsp Rasam powder & 1 tsp black pepper-cumin powder

instructions.title: Boil Tamarind Soup Base
instructions.description: In a pot, boil the tamarind water, mashed tomatoes, rasam powder, and salt together for 10 minutes until raw smell disappears.

instructions.title: Prepare Tempering
instructions.description: Heat ghee. Splutter mustard seeds, crushed garlic, black pepper-cumin powder, and curry leaves.

instructions.title: Combine & Simmer
instructions.description: Pour the hot tempering over the boiling rasam. Simmer for 2 minutes, turn off heat, and serve hot.

title: Avial
description: Traditional Kerala dish containing mixed vegetables cooked in a coconut-yogurt paste, drizzled with coconut oil.
ingredients: 2 cups Mixed vegetables (carrot, raw banana, drumstick, ash gourd, pumpkin), sliced lengthwise

instructions.title: Steam Mixed Veggies
instructions.description: Cook the sliced vegetables with minimal water, salt, and turmeric until tender but firm.

instructions.title: Add Coconut Paste
instructions.description: Grind grated coconut, green chilies, and cumin seeds coarsely. Fold this paste into the cooked vegetables. Cook for 3 minutes.

instructions.title: Finish with Yogurt & Oil
instructions.description: Reduce heat, stir in the yogurt. Drizzle coconut oil and throw in fresh curry leaves. Simmer for 1 minute without boiling.

title: Appam
description: South Indian thin lacy pancakes made of fermented rice batter and coconut milk, soft in the center and crispy on the edges.
ingredients: 2 cups Raw rice, soaked for 4 hours

instructions.title: Ferment Batter
instructions.description: Grind soaked rice, grated coconut, and cooked rice with water into a smooth batter. Stir in yeast and sugar. Let ferment overnight (8 hours).

instructions.title: Pour and Swirl
instructions.description: Heat an appam kadai. Pour a ladle of batter and swirl the pan to coat sides, leaving a thick pool in the center.

instructions.title: Steam Appam
instructions.description: Cover and cook on medium heat for 2 minutes until edges turn golden and crispy while the center remains soft. Serve warm with coconut milk.
